summary: The diff implements all requested requirements for quantity tracking and sell functionality. The backend adds quantity field to SemenStraw and Sale type with CRUD operations. The frontend adds quantity inputs in AddStrawForm and EditStrawForm, displays quantity in InventoryTable, adds sell buttons, implements SaleDialog for recording sales, and creates SalesHistory page. All acceptance criteria appear to be met.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend migration module (migration.mo) that migrates old SemenStraw records without quantity to new format with quantity defaulting to 1
hallucinated_features.reason: Migration functionality was not requested in the BuildRequest. The BuildRequest only asked for adding quantity tracking, not migrating existing data.

hallucinated_features.description: Buyer contact field in Sale type and SaleDialog form
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-11 specifies 'buyer information' which could reasonably include contact, but explicitly lists only 'saleId, strawId, saleDate, buyerName, quantitySold, and salePrice' - buyerContact was not in the specified fields.
